Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was
struck while turning left, and reports right shoulder pain since the impact. The
mechanism and force of the collision are consistent with the shoulder injury
described. Over the course of 20 visits, care followed a typical progression of
physical therapy, range-of-motion work, and home exercise instruction, with visit
frequency tapering as symptoms improved. Examination shows findings that support a
soft tissue injury to the shoulder, including localized tenderness and reduced range
of motion on elevation, while other orthopedic and neurological tests remain within
normal limits. Review of the patient's history notes a minor strain in the same region
several years earlier, which resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billed
services are documented individually, with no duplicate or repeated charges
identified. Current assessment is a resolving shoulder strain, with continued home
exercise and reassessment as needed.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
